content: W3C WAI guidance says keyboard shortcuts augment rather than replace standard focusable controls, arrow keys already carry conventional behavior inside composite widgets, and assignments should avoid browser, OS, and assistive-technology conflicts. MDN recommends ignoring already-defaultPrevented key events, handling KeyboardEvent.key, and calling preventDefault only for events actually handled. Jay-6 global Up and Down cycling must yield to focused form or composite controls, keep Hold inert, preserve left and right bank behavior and scroll suppression, and expose the action through normal variation controls and documentation.
